purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Deir Ez Zor

queries.query: Deir ez-Zor Syria official cadastral map parcel cadastre registry
queries.result: Search identified the Syrian General Directorate of Real Estate Affairs, an official SANA report on electronic cadastral-record services, and general city/map pages. No public Deir ez-Zor parcel viewer or anonymous ID+geometry endpoint was identified.

queries.query: دير الزور السجل العقاري الخريطة العقارية cadastre
queries.result: Search identified the official General Directorate of Real Estate Affairs page, an official Deir ez-Zor governorate channel report describing the cadastral survey directorate's boundary-verification procedure, and the official SANA electronic-service report. No public parcel geometry service was found.

registryEvidence.basis: First-party evidence identifies the national real-estate-affairs directorate and a Deir ez-Zor cadastral survey directorate performing boundary verification against cadastral plans. This establishes a local cadastral custodian/procedure, not an open parcel data service.

officialSources.observation: Official government directory page for the General Directorate of Real Estate Affairs under the Ministry of Local Administration and Environment.
Deir ez-Zor governorate channel search result reports the cadastral survey directorate conducting property-boundary verification using cadastral plans.

Official SANA report says electronic cadastral-record service coverage currently includes Damascus, Daraa, Quneitra and Latakia, with expansion to other governorates planned; Deir ez-Zor is not listed.
Official electronic-services portal was attempted directly but timed out before a page or public map/API configuration could be retrieved.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Deir ez-Zor cadastral survey procedure and Syrian national real-estate-affairs/electronic-service information evidenced by first-party sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No official public map viewer, service configuration, schema/CRS, or bounded anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: A zero point hit, service timeout, or absence from current electronic-service coverage does not establish citywide cadastral absence. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, certificate exception, or owner/address/titleholder fields were used. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
